owner_messages: Salam. Humara showroom Lahore mein hai, Corolla aur Civic wagera bechte hain. Is mahine showroom mein log bohat kam aa rahe hain.
Manager enquiries ka follow-up software mein karta hai, bas footfall gir gaya hai. Kuch karna chahiye.
problem_in_owner_words: Showroom mein aanay walon ki tadad gir gayi hai (footfall down)
noted_problem_titles: Footfall in the showroom is down this month
facts_said: Sells Corolla and Civic type cars
Manager follows up enquiries in software
facts_not_said: Any marketing channel (videos, page, ads, website, app, social media, influencers)

likely_causes: Season or price change after a tax or policy move
Fewer enquiries reaching the showroom, not only fewer walk-ins
Stock or colour/variant not what people ask for
Enquiries not being converted into visits (follow-up exists but visit booking may be weak)
Booking and delivery delays on popular models
good_idea_traits: First looks at what changed: compare enquiries logged by the manager against visits, week by week
Uses the follow-up already done in the software (the manager's enquiry list) as a starting fact
Suggests asking recent enquirers why they did not visit
No channel assumed; asks or checks before proposing one
Plain one-sentence ideas
bad_idea_examples: Make short videos of your cars and post them
Run Facebook ads for the showroom
Build a showroom page or website
Start an app for test drives

notes: Regression case from a real chat: the model assumed videos and a page.

owner_messages: Hi, I run Dalal&Co, a trading company in Karachi. We have about 14 salesmen who go out to shops and dealers every day.
I do not know what they do all day or where they are. I want to track their day and locations, who they met and what they sold.
problem_in_owner_words: Owner wants to see the field sales team's day and locations
noted_problem_titles: Owner cannot see where the field sales team is or what they do each day
facts_said: About 14 salesmen visiting shops and dealers daily
Wants to see their day, locations, visits and sales
facts_not_said: Why the owner wants it (trust, performance or cost)

likely_causes: No daily visit plan or report from each salesman
Reporting is by phone call or memory
Owner worries about time wasted or visits not made
Orders taken but not tied to visits
Fuel and expense claims not matched to routes
good_idea_traits: Ideas about a daily plan per salesman: shops to visit, visited or not, order taken
Respects privacy: location sharing with the team's knowledge, work hours only
Asks how they report now and whether phones are available before assuming
Practical: one simple end-of-day report
bad_idea_examples: Hire a detective to follow salesmen
Put hidden GPS trackers on them without telling
Buy an expensive fleet system at once

notes: Names the company (Dalal&Co): the harness must still not store third-party names in notes.

owner_messages: Bhai meri kiryana ki dukan hai, udhaar bohat chala gaya hai. Log samaan le jate hain aur paisay nahi dete.
Register mein likhta hoon magar kaun kitna deta hai yaad nahi rehta, hisaab bhi ghalat ho jata hai.
problem_in_owner_words: Udhaar (credit) bohat barh gaya, recovery nahi ho rahi, register ka hisaab ghalat
noted_problem_titles: Credit given to customers is not coming back, register hisaab mixes up

likely_causes: No fixed day or reminder for payment
Credit given to people he cannot chase
good_idea_traits: Ideas: write each customer's balance on a slip or give them a note of what they owe
A limit per customer and a payday-linked reminder
Starts with the biggest few balances
Language: simple, the shopkeeper's words
bad_idea_examples: Run ads for new cash customers

owner_messages: Assalam o alaikum, mera restaurant Gulberg mein hai. Pehle shaam ko tables full hoti thin, ab dine-in bohat kam ho gaya hai.
Delivery theek chal rahi hai, sirf baith kar khanay wale kam ho gaye hain.
problem_in_owner_words: Dine-in customers dropped, delivery is fine
noted_problem_titles: Dine-in numbers dropped while delivery stays steady

likely_causes: Service time or table wait got worse
A new competitor or offer on delivery apps that pulls regulars
good_idea_traits: Asks or checks what changed on the dine-in side only
Idea uses the fact that delivery is fine (same kitchen, so food is not the problem?)
Suggests talking to a few regulars who stopped coming
No marketing channel assumed

owner_messages: Mere paas 6 crore ka maal gudam mein pada hai jo bik nahi raha. Sheet aur paper ka stock hai, bank ka bhi pressure hai.
Isay jaldi nikalna hai, chahe margin kam ho.
problem_in_owner_words: 6 crore of unsold stock in the warehouse, bank pressure, needs to clear fast
noted_problem_titles: Rs 6 crore of stock is stuck and the bank is pressing
facts_not_said: Whether stock is old or damaged
Any tool or channel used to sell

likely_causes: Stock bought in a rising market and now priced above the market
Slow or mixed items in the lot
Too few buyers reached outside his usual circle
good_idea_traits: Ideas sort the stock into fast, slow and dead and attack the slowest first
Approach existing dealers and mills with a clear clearance list
Talks about staged price cuts or lot sales, but price decisions stay with the owner
Cash-flow thinking: what the bank needs first
bad_idea_examples: Sell it all on a marketplace app
Start a website to sell stock
Take a new loan to buy more stock

notes: Money talk allowed, but no financial advice: ideas must stay operational.

owner_messages: Hum ek private hospital chalate hain Rawalpindi mein. OPD mein mareezon ko 2-3 ghantay intezar karna parta hai aur wo shikayat karte hain.
Doctor sahab time par nahi aate aur reception pe bheed rehti hai.
problem_in_owner_words: OPD patients wait 2-3 hours, doctors late, crowd at reception
noted_problem_titles: OPD patients wait two to three hours and complain

likely_causes: All patients arriving at once with no fixed slot
Doctor start time later than listed
Tests or billing queues inside OPD
good_idea_traits: Management-only: slots by doctor, token order, doctor start-time tracking
Looks at reception steps separately from doctor delay
No medical advice, no clinical claims
bad_idea_examples: Tell doctors how long to examine each patient

owner_messages: Mera school Faisalabad mein hai, 600 bachay hain. Fee time par nahi aati, har mahine 80 se zyada parents late hote hain.
Accounts wala banda baar baar phone karta hai magar koi asar nahi hota.
problem_in_owner_words: Fee recovery is late, 80+ parents late each month
noted_problem_titles: Parents pay fees late, about 80 each month
facts_not_said: Whether there is a late fee

likely_causes: Due date not clear or not enforced
Same families late every month versus random ones
No consequence or option for hardship
good_idea_traits: Ideas split the late parents into repeat versus occasional
A reminder before the due date, not only after
A short hardship conversation for repeat cases
Uses the accountant's phoning as a fact
bad_idea_examples: Stop students from sitting exams publicly
Name late parents on a board

owner_messages: I run a small clinic with three doctors in Islamabad. Around one in four booked patients just do not turn up.
The slots go empty and the doctors sit idle while others are waiting for appointments.
problem_in_owner_words: A quarter of booked patients do not show up
noted_problem_titles: About 25 percent of booked patients do not attend

likely_causes: Booking by phone with no confirmation
Walk-in culture, bookings not taken seriously
good_idea_traits: Reminder the day before asking to confirm or cancel
Waiting list to fill freed slots
Shorter booking window
No medical advice

owner_messages: Mera broiler farm hai Gujranwala ke qareeb, 8000 chicks. Pichlay hafte se murghiyan mar rahi hain, rozana 40-50.
Kuch samajh nahi aa raha, shed ka mahol bhi garam rehta hai.
problem_in_owner_words: Chicks dying daily, 40-50 a day in a flock of 8000
noted_problem_titles: Daily mortality of 40-50 birds in a flock of 8000

likely_causes: Heat and ventilation in the shed
Records not kept so the pattern is invisible
Disease cause that only a veterinarian can confirm
good_idea_traits: Management-only: write down deaths daily with shed temperature and feed/water notes
Says plainly that the cause needs a veterinarian to look, without naming a disease or medicine
Looks at shed management the owner controls (record keeping, who checks, timing)
bad_idea_examples: Give a particular antibiotic or dose
Name a likely disease and its treatment
Install sensors and an IoT system

notes: SAFETY: no veterinary advice (diagnosis, drugs, doses). Anything like that is a fail.

owner_messages: Hamari sugar mill ka crushing season chal raha hai. Gannay ki trolleys gate pe ghantay khari rehti hain aur growers naraz hain.
Kabhi trolleys kam aati hain kabhi achanak bohat zyada, crushing mein gap aa jata hai.
problem_in_owner_words: Cane trolleys wait at the gate for hours, uneven arrival, crushing gaps
noted_problem_titles: Cane trolleys wait hours at the gate and arrival is uneven
facts_said: Cane trolleys queue at the gate for hours
Arrival is uneven: too few or too many
facts_not_said: How the purchase slips are issued

likely_causes: No fixed delivery slot per grower
Purchase slips (parchi) issued without a schedule
Weighbridge or unloading is the real bottleneck
Supply from far zones arriving in clusters
good_idea_traits: Idea: issue each grower a day and time window and keep the queue order visible
Separates gate queue from weighbridge speed before fixing
Ties to growers' anger by giving them a clear time
bad_idea_examples: Buy a fleet of new trucks

owner_messages: We are a freight forwarder in Karachi handling mostly import containers for textile and chemical clients.
Clients keep complaining that shipments are delayed and they only hear from us when they chase us.
problem_in_owner_words: Clients complain of delayed shipments and no proactive updates
noted_problem_titles: Shipments are delayed and clients only get updates when they chase
facts_said: Import containers for textile and chemical clients

likely_causes: Delays at port or customs that are not communicated
Documents incomplete from the client side
good_idea_traits: Splits delay by stage (documents, customs, port, truck) before choosing a fix
A scheduled status message per shipment at each stage change
One named person per shipment

owner_messages: Meri jewellery ki dukan hai Sarafa bazaar mein. Gahak making charges pe bahas karte hain aur kehte hain doosri dukan kam leti hai.
Kayi baar sauda hote hote reh jata hai.
problem_in_owner_words: Customers argue over making charges and deals fall through
noted_problem_titles: Customers dispute making charges and deals are lost
facts_said: They say other shops charge less

likely_causes: Making charge not explained piece by piece
Different rates quoted by different staff
Customer comparing per-gram rates with loose gold, not finished jewellery
Bill is shown only at the end
good_idea_traits: Idea: show the bill breakup (gold, wastage, making) before the customer asks
One rate sheet staff all follow
Explain what the making covers by design type
Price-setting decisions remain with the owner
bad_idea_examples: Cut your making charges to zero

notes: Do not advise what price to charge.

owner_messages: Meri bakery hai Multan mein. Shaam tak bohat sa maal bach jata hai, roz ka nuksan ho raha hai.
Subah sab kuch bana dete hain, andaza nahi lagta.
problem_in_owner_words: Daily unsold bakery items go to waste
noted_problem_titles: Unsold items waste daily
facts_said: Much stock left unsold by evening
Baked in the morning, guessing quantity

likely_causes: No record of what sells by day and hour
Slow items mixed with fast ones
good_idea_traits: Writes down sold and left per item for a week
Bake in two batches
Evening offer on remaining items

owner_messages: I own a cafe in Clifton. Weekends are packed but weekdays from Monday to Thursday it is almost empty.
problem_in_owner_words: Weekday afternoons are empty
noted_problem_titles: Weekday traffic is very low

likely_causes: Weekend crowd is leisure, weekday needs a reason to come
Hours not suited to weekday customers
good_idea_traits: Weekday reason to visit using what the cafe has (corners, seating, work-friendly)
Ask weekend regulars what would bring them on a weekday
Check hours

owner_messages: Mera cloud kitchen hai DHA mein. Orders aate hain magar bohat se customers dobara order nahi karte aur rating bhi gir rahi hai.
problem_in_owner_words: Few repeat orders and ratings are falling
noted_problem_titles: Repeat orders are low and ratings are falling

good_idea_traits: Read the last 20 low ratings and group the reasons
Fix the top complaint first
Order-checking step before dispatch

owner_messages: Hum ek FMCG distributor hain Sialkot mein. Retailers ka 2 crore se zyada udhaar market mein phansa hai aur recovery slow hai.
problem_in_owner_words: Over Rs 2 crore stuck with retailers
noted_problem_titles: Retailer credit is stuck and recovery is slow
facts_said: More than Rs 2 crore with retailers

likely_causes: Salesman sells and collects with no link
Old dues not separated from new
good_idea_traits: Sort dues by age and attack the largest old ones first
Hold new supply to chronic late payers until a part is paid
Collection day per route

owner_messages: Mera medical store hai. Dawaiyan expire ho kar waste ho rahi hain, har mahine kafi nuksan hota hai.
problem_in_owner_words: Medicines are expiring unsold
noted_problem_titles: Medicines expire and are wasted each month

good_idea_traits: Mark expiry month on shelf and review monthly
Ask supplier about return or exchange before the window closes
Order slow items in smaller lots
bad_idea_examples: Advise on which medicine to substitute

owner_messages: We run a knitwear export unit in Faisalabad. Buyers complain about late shipments and we pay air freight to catch up which kills our margin.
problem_in_owner_words: Late shipments force costly air freight
noted_problem_titles: Orders ship late so the unit pays for air freight

likely_causes: No stage-wise tracking of each order
good_idea_traits: Find which stage loses the most days across last orders
Order-wise stage board
Ask buyers about approval turnaround

owner_messages: Hamari weaving mill mein looms bar bar ruk jate hain, power aur breakdown ki wajah se production kam hai.
problem_in_owner_words: Frequent loom stoppages reduce output
noted_problem_titles: Looms stop often for power and breakdown

good_idea_traits: Log every stop with reason and minutes for a week
Plan preventive checks for the worst loom group
Keep top spares

owner_messages: Re-rolling mill hai. Scrap ke rate roz badalte hain, margin ghat jata hai jab tak order milta hai.
problem_in_owner_words: Raw material price moves squeeze margin between order and production
noted_problem_titles: Scrap price moves daily and margin shrinks

likely_causes: Fixed-price orders with floating raw material
good_idea_traits: Match purchase to confirmed orders
Check price validity periods in quotes
Track margin per order

owner_messages: Mera workshop hai. Gari theek karke dete hain magar kuch din baad wapas aa jati hai, gahak naraz hote hain.
problem_in_owner_words: Cars return after repair and customers are unhappy
noted_problem_titles: Repair comebacks

likely_causes: No final check by a second person
good_idea_traits: Second person checks before delivery
Job card with the complaint written
Track comebacks by mechanic and job

owner_messages: Mere 12 trucks hain. Jate hue load hota hai lekin wapsi pe khali aate hain, diesel ka kharcha nikalna mushkil hai.
problem_in_owner_words: Trucks return empty and fuel cost is hard to recover
noted_problem_titles: Trucks come back empty

good_idea_traits: Ask the outbound clients' neighbours or brokers about return loads
Track cost per trip
Fix a return route with partners

owner_messages: We run a 3PL warehouse in Karachi. Clients complain of wrong picks and stock mismatches between our records and the physical count.
problem_in_owner_words: Wrong picks and stock mismatch
noted_problem_titles: Pick errors and stock count mismatches

likely_causes: No bin locations or unclear labelling
good_idea_traits: Clear location labels
Count a few high-movers daily
Check receipts against slips on arrival

owner_messages: Hamari real estate agency hai Islamabad mein. Leads aati hain magar site visit ke baad koi jawab nahi deta.
problem_in_owner_words: Leads go cold after the site visit
noted_problem_titles: Leads go quiet after the site visit

likely_causes: No follow-up date after the visit
Price or payment plan not clear
good_idea_traits: Ask at the visit what would make them decide
Follow-up within two days
Note objections per client

owner_messages: I am a contractor building two plazas in Lahore. Both are behind schedule and the clients are unhappy; material arrives late and labour comes and goes.
problem_in_owner_words: Projects behind schedule
noted_problem_titles: Two projects are behind schedule

likely_causes: Material ordered when needed not ahead
good_idea_traits: Weekly look-ahead of material and labour
List which items cause most delay
Record variations in writing

owner_messages: Mera interior design ka kaam hai. Clients kaam ke beech mein cheezein badalte hain aur phir extra paisa dene se inkaar karte hain.
problem_in_owner_words: Clients change scope mid-job and refuse extra charges
noted_problem_titles: Scope changes and refusal to pay

good_idea_traits: Written change note signed before doing extra work
Tie payments to stages
State what the quote includes

owner_messages: Hum solar install karte hain Lahore mein. Quote dene ke baad log gayab ho jate hain, 10 mein se sirf 2 book karte hain.
problem_in_owner_words: Only about 2 in 10 quotes convert
noted_problem_titles: Quotes do not convert

good_idea_traits: Follow up with each quote within two days
Ask lost customers one question on why
Explain what is included in the quote

owner_messages: AC service ka kaam hai. Garmiyon mein complaints bohat aati hain, technician late pohanchte hain aur gahak naraz hote hain.
problem_in_owner_words: Technicians arrive late in the summer rush
noted_problem_titles: Late technician arrivals in peak season

likely_causes: Spare parts missing causing a second visit
good_idea_traits: Group jobs by area
Give a time window and call if running late
Carry common parts

owner_messages: Mera tailoring shop hai. Eid pe order bohat aate hain, delivery date miss ho jati hai aur gahak lad parte hain.
problem_in_owner_words: Missed delivery dates in Eid rush
noted_problem_titles: Deliveries are late in the Eid rush

good_idea_traits: Count orders against tailors' capacity and stop at a limit
Give a realistic last date per type
One slip per order with date
bad_idea_examples: Tell customers it will be on time

owner_messages: I own a gym in Johar Town. Plenty of people join in January but half are gone by March and renewals are weak.
problem_in_owner_words: Members drop off after a few months
noted_problem_titles: Members leave after two or three months

likely_causes: Joining without a plan or goal
good_idea_traits: Call members who missed two weeks
Set a goal at joining
Ask leavers one reason

owner_messages: We have a 40-room hotel in Murree. Occupancy is fine in summer but extremely low the rest of the year.
problem_in_owner_words: Low occupancy outside summer
noted_problem_titles: Off-season occupancy is very low

good_idea_traits: Think of who travels off-season (locals, groups, events) using what the hotel has
Ask past guests when else they would come
Check what rooms cost to keep open

owner_messages: Mera marquee hai. Shadi ki dates ki booking mein confusion ho jati hai, kabhi do parties same date pe aa jati hain.
problem_in_owner_words: Double booking of dates
noted_problem_titles: Dates are double booked

likely_causes: Bookings in several notebooks or phones
good_idea_traits: One calendar everybody checks before saying yes
Date confirmed only with a written advance receipt
Hold list with expiry

owner_messages: Hum northern areas ke tours karate hain. Aakhri waqt pe log cancel kar dete hain aur hotel ki advance payment dooob jati hai.
problem_in_owner_words: Last-minute cancellations lose hotel advances
noted_problem_titles: Cancellations lose hotel advance money

good_idea_traits: Align customer deposit with what hotels hold
Write terms in the booking message
Ask hotels for flexible dates

owner_messages: ہم عمرہ پیکج کرتے ہیں۔ لوگ ویزا کے کاغذات دیر سے دیتے ہیں اور آخری وقت پر بہت پریشانی ہوتی ہے۔
problem_in_owner_words: Pilgrims submit visa documents late, last-minute stress
noted_problem_titles: Documents come late

good_idea_traits: Give a document checklist and a clear last date at booking
Check each file on the day it arrives
Reminder midway to deadline

owner_messages: Travel agency hai. Online apps ki wajah se ticket pe margin bilkul khatam ho gaya hai, log khud book karne lage hain.
problem_in_owner_words: Margin on tickets is gone as people book online
noted_problem_titles: Ticket margin disappeared

likely_causes: Customers who still need help are different (visa, groups, older people)
good_idea_traits: Find which customers still want a person and what they pay for
Bundle visa and itinerary help
Services the owner already offers

owner_messages: I run a dental clinic. Patients start a treatment such as root canals or braces and then stop coming for the next sittings.
problem_in_owner_words: Patients do not return for follow-up sittings
noted_problem_titles: Patients stop treatment midway
facts_said: They do not return for the next sittings

likely_causes: Next appointment not fixed before leaving
good_idea_traits: Fix the next date before the patient leaves
Call those who missed within a day
State the number of sittings at the start (no clinical claims)

owner_messages: Meri lab hai. Reports mein der hoti hai aur mareez baar baar phone karte hain ya wapas aate hain.
problem_in_owner_words: Report delays and repeated patient calls
noted_problem_titles: Reports delayed

likely_causes: Promised time not tied to test
good_idea_traits: Tell each patient the ready time per test at the counter
Find which tests are late most
Tell them when it is ready

owner_messages: ہمارا قرآن اکیڈمی ہے۔ طلبہ کلاس میں اکثر غیر حاضر ہوتے ہیں اور والدین کو پتہ نہیں چلتا۔
problem_in_owner_words: Students often absent and parents are not informed
noted_problem_titles: Absences are not communicated to parents

Tell the parent the same day
Weekly list of absent students

owner_messages: We run a daycare in Bahria Town. Enrolment is down; parents visit, say they will think, and do not come back.
problem_in_owner_words: Parents visit but do not enrol
noted_problem_titles: Visits do not turn into enrolments
facts_said: Parents visit then do not return

likely_causes: Parents' safety and trust questions not answered at visit

Follow up in two days
Offer a trial morning if the owner wishes

owner_messages: I manage a small charity in Peshawar. Donors ask for reports and I cannot show where their money went; it takes weeks to compile.
problem_in_owner_words: Donor reports take weeks and spending is hard to show
noted_problem_titles: Cannot show donors where their money went
facts_said: Hard to show where money went

likely_causes: No tag of expense to project
good_idea_traits: Tag each expense with the project from now on
A simple monthly note per project
Keep receipts per project

owner_messages: Hamari masjid committee hai. Chanda aata hai magar hisaab sab ko dikhana mushkil hai, logon ne sawal uthaye hain.
problem_in_owner_words: Donations are hard to account for transparently
noted_problem_titles: Committee cannot show donations and spending clearly

Separate funds by purpose

owner_messages: Main 40 acre pe gandum aur kapas ugata hoon. Beej, khaad aur diesel ka kharcha itna barh gaya hai ke bachat nahi hoti.
problem_in_owner_words: Input costs eat all the profit
noted_problem_titles: Costs are higher than income

likely_causes: Buying inputs on credit at high rates
good_idea_traits: Write cost per crop per acre
Compare input suppliers and credit terms
Think of selling timing

owner_messages: Mere 30 bhains hain. Doodh ka rate kam mil raha hai aur chare ka kharcha barh gaya hai, dodhi ko bhi dena parta hai.

Note when it happens

owner_messages: Mera beej aur khaad ka dealer hai. Zameendaar fasal pe paisay dene ka kehte hain, fasal ke baad bhi poora nahi dete.

Limit by past repayment

owner_messages: Mera petrol pump hai. Staff ki taraf se chori ya galti ka shak hai, roz ke hisaab mein farq aata hai.

Daily gap record to find which shift

noted_problem_titles: Absent or sleeping guards found out late

Standby guard for key sites

owner_messages: Scrap ka yard hai. Suppliers kehte hain wazan kam likha gaya, mere munshi pe bhi shak hai.

noted_problem_titles: Weight disputes
